requirement.title: Keep currency usable when region lookup fails
requirement.description: When the store region or exchange-rate service fails while the provider is active, retain a usable INR currency with a rate of one.
acceptanceCriteria: An active failed region request restores currency INR and rate 1.

requirement.title: Recover valid cart rows beside negative-price rows
requirement.description: Stored browser cart data may contain an invalid negative-priced item beside a valid item. Restore the valid item and report recovery instead of discarding the entire cart.
acceptanceCriteria: A negative-priced stored row is skipped while valid rows are retained.
Restoration marks the cart recovered and the provider shows its recovery notice.

requirement.title: Clamp existing quantity after positive stock shrinks
requirement.description: When available product stock changes to a smaller positive amount, clamp an existing quantity to that amount. Preserve the current quantity when the stock amount is unknown.
acceptanceCriteria: Quantity 8 becomes 3 after available stock changes to 3.
An unknown stock amount does not trigger the quantity-clamping effect.

requirement.title: Apply approved basket volume pricing
requirement.description: Apply our approved volume discount policy to the basket. The eligibility threshold, discount amount and currency treatment have not been supplied in this request.
acceptanceCriteria: Eligible baskets receive the approved volume discount.
Discount calculation follows the approved currency treatment.
